answer: Resist sybils with a graduated bond: a new agent must lock a deposit that grows with the number of identities already funded from the same source in the past 30 days, doubling each time. Cloning is cheap at first and prohibitive at scale, so a farm of 100 fakes ties up far more capital than one honest agent. Like a prism that splits one beam into many colors, the funding graph reveals each hidden link, and a cluster that crosses a canyon of overlap loses its bond. Honest agents earn velvet-smooth, undiluted rewards.
